name: Shar
source:
A young witch from a tropical village in El'shei. She specializes in benevolent magic, like her mother, the Oracle of Chtaz. Shar attracts the attention of a more powerful and famous witch, and receives an invitation to become her assistant.

[From [url=https://www.rollingcrown.com/ice_demon/]official website[/url]]
